title: BenchmarkRepository
responsibility: Atomically persists private benchmark run records and marks abandoned live trials as interrupted.

inputs.name: BenchmarkRepository.constructor.home
inputs.description: Storage root that directory() joins each run ID to, so it must be a string path. Defaults to join(process.env.HARNESS_ANALYTICS_HOME ?? join(homedir(), '.codex', 'harness'), 'benchmarks'): the HARNESS_ANALYTICS_HOME value when it is defined, otherwise the .codex/harness folder under the home directory, with 'benchmarks' appended.

inputs.name: BenchmarkRepository.directory.id
inputs.description: Run identifier that directory() accepts only when it matches /^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/, the 36-character lowercase hex and hyphen shape randomUUID() produces. Any other value makes directory() throw the 'Invalid benchmark run ID.' error, so save() and read() reject with it too.

inputs.name: BenchmarkRepository.save.run
inputs.description: Complete run record to persist: the pinned definition, runner versions, fingerprint and the trials recorded so far. Its id must pass the directory() run-ID check, and the run must serialize with JSON.stringify (no BigInt values or circular references), otherwise save() rejects.

definition.name: cart-discount-check
definition.task: Reject expired discount codes at checkout.
definition.contract: Keep the public signature of applyDiscount() unchanged.

inputs.name: BenchmarkRepository.read.id
inputs.description: Run identifier whose run.json is read from its subfolder; it must match /^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/, or read() rejects with the 'Invalid benchmark run ID.' error. When no run.json exists for a valid ID, read() rejects with the file-system error.

outputs.name: BenchmarkRepository.directory
outputs.description: Path of the run's private subfolder: the storage root joined with the validated run ID. directory() only computes this path and does not create the folder; save() creates it with mode 0o700.

outputs.name: BenchmarkRepository.save
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after the run is written to run.json.tmp (mode 0o600) and renamed over run.json, which replaces the earlier record only at that final rename. It rejects if any step fails, and because the rename comes last, a failure before it leaves the previous run.json in place.

outputs.name: BenchmarkRepository.read
outputs.description: Resolves with the parsed run.json, in which every trial with status 'running' is reported as 'interrupted' when run.ownerPid is missing or process.kill(run.ownerPid, 0) throws. That status change exists only in the returned object: read() never writes run.json, so the file on disk keeps the status it was saved with.

definition.name: cart-discount-check
definition.task: Reject expired discount codes at checkout.
definition.contract: Keep the public signature of applyDiscount() unchanged.

errors.name: InvalidBenchmarkRunIdError
errors.description: Thrown by directory() when the run ID does not match /^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/, with the message 'Invalid benchmark run ID.'; save() and read() reject with it.

errors.name: Benchmark run filesystem failure
errors.description: Rejects save() when mkdir, writeFile or rename fails, and read() when run.json cannot be read, for example because no run was saved under that ID.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: read() rejects with it when run.json is not valid JSON.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: save() rejects with it when the run cannot be serialized (BigInt values or circular references), and read() rejects with it when the parsed record has no iterable trials array or holds a null trial.
